target.title: fix(ai): clean up abort listener after provider retry sleep
target.body:
Closes #105422

## What Problem This Solves

Long-lived OpenAI/ChatGPT provider retry waits left an `abort` listener registered on the shared request signal after every successful delay. Repeated transient failures could therefore retain promise closures for the lifetime of an agent run.

## Why This Change Was Made

The final implementation moves the abortable retry wait into a private package-internal helper. That helper removes its one-shot listener after both normal timeout completion and cancellation, clears the timer on cancellation, and preserves immediate rejection for pre-aborted signals. Keeping lifecycle coverage in a focused internal test avoids exporting a test hook through the shipped Plugin SDK surface.

## User Impact

ChatGPT-authenticated retry loops no longer accumulate orphaned abort listeners. Retry timing and caller-visible cancellation errors are unchanged.

Release-note context: **OpenAI retry cleanup:** detach abort listeners after successful ChatGPT-authenticated retry waits so repeated transient failures do not retain promise closures for the lifetime of an agent run. Thanks @wuqxuan.

## Evidence

- Testbox run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29214024537
- `pnpm test packages/ai/src/internal/retry-sleep.test.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-chatgpt-responses.test.ts` — 36 tests passed.
- `pnpm check:changed` — passed, including Plugin SDK API baseline, tsgo, lint, import-cycle, and boundary guards.
- Fresh branch autoreview — clean, no actionable findings.
- Current-main contrast: the prior inline helper resolved its timeout without calling `removeEventListener`.
- Live paid-provider turn: not required; the defect and fix are entirely in local EventTarget/timer ownership and are proved at that boundary.

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: After a successful retry sleep, the abort listener registered on the caller's long-lived signal is removed so repeated waits do not accumulate listeners/closures; abort mid-wait and already-aborted paths still reject with `Request was aborted` and clean up.
- Environment: local macOS openclaw checkout, Node v24.17.0, PR head `5710d2028112cd1c819c4ccd12de6bd4ba541e28` (`fix/105422-abort-listener-sleep`).
- Entry point exercised: `packages/ai/src/internal/retry-sleep.ts` → `sleepWithAbort` (same helper imported by `openai-chatgpt-responses.ts` retry call sites).
- Current-main contrast: successful timer completion previously left the abort listener on the signal; this head removes it on both resolve and abort paths.
- Exact commands run after this patch:

```text
# 1) Direct runtime exercise of the helper (not spy-only narrative)
PROOF_HEAD=5710d2028112cd1c819c4ccd12de6bd4ba541e28 node --experimental-strip-types /tmp/proof-retry-sleep.mjs

# 2) Focused Vitest (helper lifecycle + provider suite)
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/internal/retry-sleep.test.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-chatgpt-responses.test.ts
```

- Terminal transcript after fix (runtime helper path, 2026-07-13 00:28:49 UTC):

```text
=== Real behavior proof: sleepWithAbort listener lifecycle ===
host: local macOS
node: v24.17.0
cwd: /Users/wuqingxuan/openclaw
head: 5710d2028112cd1c819c4ccd12de6bd4ba541e28
helper: packages/ai/src/internal/retry-sleep.ts → sleepWithAbort

[case1] successful wait
  elapsed_ms≈ 21
  abort_add_count= 1
  abort_remove_count= 1
  same_fn_ref= true
  PASS= true
[case2] three successful waits on one signal (no accumulation)
  abort_add_count= 3
  abort_remove_count= 3
  each_add_removed_same_ref= true
  PASS= true
[case3] abort during wait
  error= Request was aborted
  abort_remove_count= 1
  PASS= true
[case4] already-aborted signal
  error= Request was aborted
  elapsed_ms≈ 0
  PASS= true

=== summary ===
ALL_PASS
```

- Focused Vitest after fix:

```text
✓ |unit| packages/ai/src/providers/openai-chatgpt-responses.test.ts (32 tests)
✓ |unit| packages/ai/src/internal/retry-sleep.test.ts (4 tests)
Test Files  2 passed (2)
     Tests  36 passed (36)
```

- Observed result after fix: each successful wait has matched `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener` on the same function reference; three waits leave 3 adds and 3 removes (no residual accumulation); abort mid-wait and pre-aborted signals reject with `Request was aborted` and still unregister.
- Control check: assertions bind the same listener function reference for add vs remove; provider suite still green (retry delay policy / error mapping unchanged).
- What was not tested: live paid OpenAI/ChatGPT cloud turns; heap profiling under production load; competing PR #105478 merge conflict resolution.

## AI disclosure

Original fix authored with AI assistance (Grok); maintainer refactor and verification performed during OpenClaw review. Real-behavior proof transcript added after ClawSweeper needs-proof review.
